evidence: Deterministic analytical event schedule; not measured or calibrated
model_geometry_provenance: Unchanged from 2026-09-13 source parameters.json; no new model run

schedule.prefetch_submission: Next batch at the start of current batch computation
schedule.readiness: All historical KV of a batch must be ready before its first layer computes
schedule.lookahead: One batch only; no submission of the batch after next
schedule.transfer: One serialized H2D stream, overlapping a serialized layer compute stream
schedule.memory: Keep copied history KV. Sufficient HBM for complete history plus new KV; not a two-buffer memory cap
schedule.failure_relation: Conditional recovery replay example; the overlap mechanism is not exclusive to failure
